name: cursor-bridge
description: Hand tasks to Cursor agents and get their final reply back: local read-only reviews of uncommitted work, or cloud agents on a branch.

cursor_api_key.title: Cursor API key (optional)
cursor_api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your Cursor account in the browser instead (ask Claude to sign in to Cursor). Or paste a key from Cursor Dashboard > API Keys. Runs bill the account behind the key.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Used when a call names no model, e.g. composer-2.5 or grok-4.6:effort=high. Ask Claude to run cursor_models for the list.

allow_local_writes.title: Allow local write access
allow_local_writes.description: Lets a local Cursor agent edit files and run commands on this machine when a call asks for access "full". Leave off unless you need it.
